issues.title: Defence, security cooperation is an important pillar of Vietnam–Laos ties: PM
issues.title_en: Defence, security cooperation is an important pillar of Vietnam–Laos ties: PM
issues.summary: Expressing his pleasure at the positive development of the special relationship between Vietnam and Laos, the PM highlighted defence and security cooperation as an important pillar of the bilateral ties. He praised the two defence ministries and armies for implementing high-level agreements, strengthening mutual trust and helping maintain a peaceful and stable environment conducive to socio-economic development. PM’s visit injects fresh momentum into Vietnam-Laos special relations Vietnam, Laos strengthen defence cooperation Vietnam, Laos strengthen cooperation in combating transnational crime
